title: D4-A2-V1-R1 Historical Contrast Shared-Plan Replay Preregistration

implementation_freeze_contract.description: Implementation freeze identity is defined non-self-referentially as the Git commit containing this preregistration (Commit A). The runtime execution runner captures git rev-parse HEAD dynamically before formal Cell #1, verifies a clean worktree, and records that exact Commit A SHA in raw artifacts and closeout.

scientific_scope.query: The restgas analysis determines the event vertex through a two-step POCA workflow. What does the first worker step leave behind for the second analysis step, and how is the fitted vertex fed into the reprocessing?
scientific_scope.excluded_cases: No other novel_dev cases, no Gold cases, no novel_validation, no holdout.

shared_plan_adapter_guarantees.plan_identity: actual_plan_used == frozen_plan (verified by canonical model_dump equality)
shared_plan_adapter_guarantees.adapter_lifecycle: Restores Retriever.analyze on cell completion or exception; fail-closed on error.

arm_definitions.BEFORE_COMPAT: Production query expansions with Batch-1 fixed locators active, generic D3.5 structured replacement OFF, reserved admission OFF.
arm_definitions.AFTER_BATCH1_REPLACEMENT: Exact in-memory Batch-1 component mask active, generic D3.5 structured replacement ON, d3_5_selectivity_v2 ON (caps 8/4), K=3 reserved admission, rerank pool size = 30.

verdict_precedence.condition: Wrong historical plans, ambiguous source cells, plan injection mismatch, Analyzer provider call > 0, wrong cell matrix, wrong mask, post-exposure mutation, protected-data violation, or incomplete execution.
PAIR_TREATMENT_REGRESSION_COUNT >= 1 at pre-rerank availability. Any T->F pre-rerank treatment pair is Level 2 FAIL.
PAIR_TREATMENT_REGRESSION_COUNT = 0 but one or more final-only AFTER regressions occur (FINAL_ONLY_REGRESSION_COUNT >= 1).
HIST_A2_BEFORE_PLAN x BEFORE_COMPAT does not retain n022.e2 in the pre-rerank pool.
HIST_A2_BEFORE_PLAN x BEFORE = retained AND HIST_A2_AFTER_PLAN x BEFORE = retained, or otherwise frozen historical plans fail to create expected pre-rerank contrast under common compatibility path.

4/4 valid cells, ANALYZER_CALLS = 0, HIST_A2_BEFORE_PLAN x BEFORE retains n022.e2, HIST_A2_AFTER_PLAN x BEFORE loses n022.e2, HISTORICAL_PLAN_SENSITIVITY_REPRODUCED = true, PAIR_TREATMENT_REGRESSION_COUNT = 0, FINAL_ONLY_REGRESSION_COUNT = 0, Batch-1 direct match = false.
